meta.title: Re-New Platform: Editorial Systems Mood Board
meta.subtitle: Clear momentum, calm confidence, executive trust
meta.brief: A visual direction board for Re-New, an internal CRM and repreneur acceleration platform. The board should feel sharp, editorial, and futurist minimal while staying grounded in practical work surfaces, structured systems, and product scenes.
meta.audience: Re-New founders, operators, repreneurs, advisors, sellers, and intermediaries who need to trust that the platform turns acquisition readiness into a visible operating system.
meta.generatedTileRule: Each image is one single visual reference image, not a mini mood board, collage, grid, or layout.

signals.goal: Establish a premium but practical visual world for an internal CRM evolving into a repreneur-facing acceleration platform.
context: Repreneurs, opportunities, offers, assessments, journey stages, documents, Wavy assistant
Existing interface palette: white, charcoal, slate, restrained blue accents, light grey structure
principles: Editorial realism over generic SaaS stock
Visible structure without readable UI text
Clean surfaces, precise spacing, restrained color
No literal brand marks or private data
